name: Yakushima
blurb: Yakushima features ancient cedar forests, rainy mountain hiking trails, and coastal beaches. Travelers frequently note long travel routes required to reach the island.

positive: Enjoyable rainforest hiking despite getting soaked
Fascinating ancient cedar trees and moss-covered landscapes
Delicious local tea and sampling events
negative: Heavy rainfall and record-breaking storm totals
Complicated or exhausting multi-modal transit days
Issues with hotel room odors and poor accommodations
